name: Norms: what Axelrod left unstated (Galán & Izquierdo note 4)
description: What Axelrod did not say: how the offspring are brought back to 20 ('For convenience, the number of offspring is adjusted') and what happens when every payoff ties (Galán & Izquierdo's note 4: it 'can alter the long-term results significantly'). The metanorms game; the metric is the share of runs collapsed. Measured (release, seeds 1–10, recorded 2026-09-26): after 10 000 generations 0 (random refill, ties drift — G&I's reading), 0 (random, ties kept), 0.7 (ranked refill, ties drift) and 0.5 (ranked, kept). A ranked refill loses the norm within 10 000 generations; the tie rule shows by 10⁵ — ties drifting, 43 of 100 runs collapsed; ties kept, 3 (100 seeds, measured in planning; the survey's 50 seeds: drift 20, kept 1).
